tldr: Saturn in Aquarius: discipline must be learned through community, systems, and future responsibility.
body: With Saturn in Aquarius, the work is understanding your role inside the collective without surrendering your individuality. Saturn is at home here, so vision becomes powerful when it is structured.
gift: Systemic thinking, social responsibility, innovation with discipline, and durable community work.
challenge: Detachment, superiority, or using ideals to avoid personal accountability.
note: Authored from Marie Satori planet-through-sign material.
